## Weekly Plan

The plan below maps the six syllabus modules (40 lecture hours) onto the semester; it is **tentative** and will firm up once the elective slot is announced. Readings refer to the [primary text](./resources.qmd) (*The Principles of Diffusion Models*, arXiv:2510.21890).

| Week | Dates | Module · Topics |
|:---:|---|---|
| [01](weeks/w01.qmd) | Jul 29 – 31 | **M1** Foundations of generative modeling: data distributions & model families, ML estimation, KL divergence |
| [02](weeks/w02.qmd) | Aug 3 – 7 | **M1** Empirical risk minimization; challenges of high-dimensional density estimation |
| [03](weeks/w03.qmd) | Aug 10 – 14 | **M2** Multivariate Gaussians: conditioning, marginalization, linear transformations |
| [04](weeks/w04.qmd) | Aug 17 – 21 | **M2** Discrete-time Markov chains; noise accumulation via repeated Gaussian perturbation. *CT-1 window opens Aug 19* |
| [05](weeks/w05.qmd) | Aug 24 – 28 | **M3** DDPM I: forward diffusion process; concept of the reverse process |
| [06](weeks/w06.qmd) | Aug 31 – Sep 4 | **M3** DDPM II: variational lower bound, KL decomposition, reduction to noise-prediction loss |
| [07](weeks/w07.qmd) | Sep 7 – 11 | **M4** Score functions; score matching |
| [08](weeks/w08.qmd) | Sep 14 – 18 | **M4** Denoising score matching; synthesis of M1–M4. *Mid-sem begins Fri Sep 18* |
| [09](weeks/w09.qmd) | Sep 21 – 25 | **Mid-Semester Examinations (Sep 18–23)** — covers M1–M4 |
| [10](weeks/w10.qmd) | Sep 28 – Oct 2 | **M5** Random walks and Brownian motion; concept of an SDE |
| [11](weeks/w11.qmd) | Oct 5 – 9 | **M5** Heat-equation intuition; density evolution under stochastic dynamics (Fokker–Planck) |
| [12](weeks/w12.qmd) | Oct 12 – 16 | **M5** Continuous formulation of the forward equation. *CT-2 window opens Oct 14* |
| [13](weeks/w13.qmd) | Oct 19 – 23 | **M6** Reverse-time drift (heuristic derivation). *Mon–Tue are Dussehra holidays* |
| [14](weeks/w14.qmd) | Oct 26 – 30 | **M6** Entropy and information-flow interpretation |
| [15](weeks/w15.qmd) | Nov 2 – 6 | **M6** Probability flow ODE |
| [16](weeks/w16.qmd) | Nov 9 – 13 | **M6** Neural ODEs and flow-based models. *Mon–Wed are holidays (Diwali cluster)* |
| [17](weeks/w17.qmd) | Nov 16 – 20 | Wrap-up: applications and extensions; revision. *Last day of classes Fri Nov 20* |

: {tbl-colwidths="[7,18,75]"}

::: {.callout-note}
Module hours per the syllabus: M1–M4 are 6 hours each; M5–M6 are 8 hours each (40 total). With ~3 lecture hours/week and the holiday weeks above, the mapping will be tuned once the actual class days are known.
:::
